tax_review.note: Interstate sales are flagged for CPA review when any of these facts is missing. LedgerSight never decides nexus or taxability and never computes, files or remits tax.

required_inputs.taxability: taxability of the goods or service in the destination state
required_inputs.nexus_status: seller's nexus status in the destination state
required_inputs.dest_registration: seller's sales-tax registration in the destination state

fx.note: Exchange-rate sources approved by the firm, e.g. {"from": "GBP", "to": "USD", "source": "..."}. Empty means none is approved, so a cross-currency payment is never converted or auto-matched.
